direction.camera: Guide attention with scientific clarity; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: move from one observed detail to a legible explanatory structure; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with experimental proof; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with measured reveal.
direction.lighting: cool lab-like fill; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: clear glass and precise technical marks; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around quiet wonder; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use scientific clarity,experimental proof,ordered diagram,precise label,quiet wonder,measured reveal as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
